2607.27443.title: Leveraging Trajectory Graphs for Pre-Execution Error Diagnosis in Agentic LLM Systems
2607.27443.paper_summary: Large Language Model~(LLM)-based agents have demonstrated exceptional performance across a wide range of complex interactive tasks. However, they often struggle with long-horizon interactive tasks common in domains, such as embodied AI. The complexity and vast action spaces in these settings lead to compounding errors, where a single suboptimal action can derail an entire trajectory, causing the agent to exhaust its limited step budget on inefficient or unrecoverable paths. To overcome this without costly fine-tuning, we draw inspiration from software debugging, where execution logs are analyzed to preemptively catch errors. We propose \textit{Trajectory Graph Copilot}, a novel framework that acts as a ``copilot'' for LLM agents by diagnosing potential action errors before they are executed. At its core,\textit{Graph Debugger} models historical trajectories as a probabilistic graph and uses a Graph Neural Network to identify sequential action patterns that frequently lead to failure. Functioning as a proactive diagnostic sandbox, our method provides early warnings on potentially flawed actions, prompting the agent to self-correct. This pre-action error diagnosis prevents costly mistakes, significantly enhancing the agent's ability to complete long-horizon tasks successfully. The extensive experiments on four benchmarks with three LLM agents demonstrate a $14.69\%$ pass ratio improvement on average.
2607.27443.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）基礎的代理在各種複雜的互動任務中展現了卓越的表現。<lb/>然而，它們在長期互動任務中常常面臨挑戰，這些任務在具身人工智慧等領域中十分普遍。<lb/>這些環境中的複雜性和龐大的行動空間導致了累積錯誤，單一的次優行動可能會使整個軌跡偏離，導致代理在低效或不可恢復的路徑上耗盡其有限的步驟預算。<lb/>為了在不進行昂貴的微調的情況下克服這一問題，我們從軟體除錯中獲取靈感，該過程中分析執行日誌以預先捕捉錯誤。<lb/>我們提出了\textit{Trajectory Graph Copilot}，這是一個新穎的框架，作為LLM代理的“副駕駛”，在執行之前診斷潛在的行動錯誤。<lb/>在其核心，\textit{Graph Debugger}將歷史軌跡建模為一個概率圖，並使用圖神經網絡來識別經常導致失敗的順序行動模式。<lb/>作為一個主動的診斷沙箱，我們的方法提供了對潛在缺陷行動的早期警告，促使代理自我修正。<lb/>這種行動前錯誤診斷防止了昂貴的錯誤，顯著提升了代理成功完成長期任務的能力。<lb/>在四個基準上對三個LLM代理進行的廣泛實驗顯示，平均通過率提高了$14.69\%$。
